title: Non-conforming uses
previewText: In Special Enhanced Commercial Districts 2 and 3, the regulations of Article V, Chapter 2, shall be modified so that the discontinuance provisions of Section 52-60 shall not apply to such change of use within establishments with non-conforming street wall widths.
